تختلسي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِسِي (taḵtalisī) /tax.ta.li.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# تُخْتَلَسِي (tuḵtalasī) /tux.ta.la.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
